name: vitals
description: A live sidebar of the session's vitals: prompt cache, context, spend and today's usage, edited files you can open in Zed, background tasks, and a pixel claw that reacts to it all.

autoOpen.title: Open on session start
autoOpen.description: Open the sidebar when a session starts in the fullscreen layout at 144 columns or wider.

columns.title: Sidebar width
columns.description: Columns the docked sidebar asks for. A width you drag it to wins.

zedPath.title: Zed CLI path
zedPath.description: Full path to Zed's command-line tool. Empty: zed on PATH, then /Applications/Zed.app/Contents/MacOS/cli.

ccusageCommand.title: ccusage command
ccusageCommand.description: How to run ccusage: pnpx ccusage, npx -y ccusage@20, or ccusage when it is installed.

ccusageRefreshSeconds.title: ccusage refresh (seconds)
ccusageRefreshSeconds.description: How often usage figures refresh in the background. They also refresh after each turn, at most every 30 seconds.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.description: auto: pixel pictures in kitty and Ghostty, coloured text elsewhere. pixels or text forces one.

character.title: Show the claw
character.description: The pixel claw in the header, reacting to the session.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Animate the claw and the cache bar. Off draws still frames.
